title.narrative: Emergency Food, Water and Protection interventions for Drought-affected Populati

description.narrative: The Swedish International Development Agency (Sida) Rapid Response Mechanism (RRM) will support in scaling up Oxfam's and SADO's emergency drought response across Somalia, particularly in the drought hotspots of Gedo/Jubaland and Sool/Eastern Somaliland. The focus will be on integrated Food Security, Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) and Protection, targeting 17,910 (3940 Female (under 18), 5731 Female (over 18), 3582 Male (under 18) and 4657 Male (over 18) Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) and host communities across the two regions. The proposed activities will address the acute water and food shortages through multipurpose cash transfers, water trucking, rehabilitation/extension of key water points in IDP camps and the provision of hygiene kits and household solar lights to mitigate protection risks. To ensure the sustainability of our actions, it is planned to rehabilitate and extend crucial water sources in rapidly growing IDP camps which receive new daily arrivals displaced by drought, and to set up public solar streetlights in key areas of IDP settlements to counter protection risks at water points and main streets. Service mapping in target locations will accompany our interventions and link the target communities to existing service providers, supporting the integrated nature of this response.
